name: Gurdurr
description: Gurdurr excels at demolition—construction is not its forte. In any case, there’s skill in the way this Pokémon wields its metal beam.

moves.name: Pound
moves.description: The target is physically pounded with a long tail, a foreleg, or the like.

moves.name: Leer
moves.description: The user gives opposing Pokémon an intimidating leer that lowers their Defense stats.

moves.name: Low Kick
moves.description: A powerful low kick that makes the target fall over. The heavier the target, the greater the move's power.

moves.name: Rock Throw
moves.description: The user picks up and throws a small rock at the target to inflict damage.

moves.name: Focus Energy
moves.description: The user takes a deep breath and focuses so that its future attacks have a heightened chance of landing critical hits.

moves.name: Bulk Up
moves.description: The user tenses its muscles to bulk up its body, boosting its Attack and Defense stats.

moves.name: Rock Slide
moves.description: Large boulders are hurled at opposing Pokémon to inflict damage. This may also make the opposing Pokémon flinch.

moves.name: Slam
moves.description: The target is slammed with a long tail, vines, or the like to inflict damage.

moves.name: Scary Face
moves.description: The user frightens the target with a scary face to harshly lower its Speed stat.

moves.name: Dynamic Punch
moves.description: The user attacks by punching the target with full concentrated power. This also confuses the target.

moves.name: Hammer Arm
moves.description: The user swings its strong, heavy fist at the target to inflict damage. This also lowers the user's Speed stat.

moves.name: Stone Edge
moves.description: The user stabs the target with sharpened stones. This move has a heightened chance of landing a critical hit.

moves.name: Superpower
moves.description: The user attacks the target with great power. This also lowers the user's Attack and Defense stats.

moves.name: Focus Punch
moves.description: The user focuses its mind before launching a punch. This move fails if the user is hit before using the move.

moves.name: Fire Punch
moves.description: The target is attacked with a fiery punch. This may also leave the target with a burn.

moves.name: Ice Punch
moves.description: The target is attacked with an icy punch. This may also leave the target frozen.

moves.name: Thunder Punch
moves.description: The target is attacked with an electrified punch. This may also leave the target with paralysis.

moves.name: Take Down
moves.description: A reckless full-body charge attack for slamming into the target. This also damages the user a little.

moves.name: Double-Edge
moves.description: A reckless life-risking tackle in which the user rushes the target. This also damages the user quite a lot.

moves.name: Low Kick
moves.description: A powerful low kick that makes the target fall over. The heavier the target, the greater the move's power.

moves.name: Dig
moves.description: The user burrows into the ground on the first turn, then attacks on the next turn.

moves.name: Rest
moves.description: The user goes to sleep for two turns. This fully restores the user's HP and cures any status conditions.

moves.name: Rock Slide
moves.description: Large boulders are hurled at opposing Pokémon to inflict damage. This may also make the opposing Pokémon flinch.

moves.name: Substitute
moves.description: The user creates a substitute for itself using some of its own HP. The substitute serves as the user's decoy.

moves.name: Thief
moves.description: The user attacks and steals the target's held item simultaneously. The user can't steal anything if it already holds an item.

moves.name: Curse
moves.description: A move that has different effects depending on whether the user is a Ghost type or not.

moves.name: Reversal
moves.description: An all-out attack that becomes more powerful the less HP the user has.

moves.name: Protect
moves.description: This move enables the user to protect itself from all attacks. Its chance of failing rises if it is used in succession.

moves.name: Scary Face
moves.description: The user frightens the target with a scary face to harshly lower its Speed stat.

moves.name: Endure
moves.description: The user endures any attack with at least 1 HP. This move's chance of failing rises if used in succession.

moves.name: Sleep Talk
moves.description: The user randomly uses one of the moves it knows. This move can only be used while the user is asleep.

moves.name: Rain Dance
moves.description: The user summons a heavy rain that falls for five turns, powering up Water-type attacks. The rain also lowers the power of Fire-type attacks.

moves.name: Sunny Day
moves.description: The user intensifies the sun for five turns, powering up Fire-type attacks. The sunlight also lowers the power of Water-type attacks.

moves.name: Facade
moves.description: This move's power is doubled if the user is poisoned, burned, or paralyzed.

moves.name: Focus Punch
moves.description: The user focuses its mind before launching a punch. This move fails if the user is hit before using the move.

moves.name: Taunt
moves.description: The target is taunted into a rage that allows it to use only attack moves for three turns.

moves.name: Helping Hand
moves.description: The user assists an ally by boosting the power of that ally's attack.

moves.name: Brick Break
moves.description: The user attacks with a swift chop. This move can also break barriers, such as Light Screen and Reflect.

moves.name: Knock Off
moves.description: The user slaps down the target's held item, making it unusable for that battle. This move does more damage if the target has a held item.

moves.name: Rock Tomb
moves.description: The user hurls boulders at the target to inflict damage. This also lowers the target's Speed stat by cutting off its movement.

moves.name: Bulk Up
moves.description: The user tenses its muscles to bulk up its body, boosting its Attack and Defense stats.

moves.name: Close Combat
moves.description: The user fights the target up close, inflicting damage without guarding itself. This also lowers the user's Defense and Sp. Def stats.

moves.name: Fling
moves.description: The user flings its held item at the target to attack. This move's power and effects depend on the item.

moves.name: Poison Jab
moves.description: The target is stabbed with a tentacle, an arm, or the like steeped in poison. This may also poison the target.

moves.name: Drain Punch
moves.description: The user attacks with an energy-draining punch. The user's HP is restored by up to half the damage taken by the target.

moves.name: Focus Blast
moves.description: The user heightens its mental focus and unleashes its power. This may also lower the target's Sp. Def stat.

moves.name: Stone Edge
moves.description: The user stabs the target with sharpened stones. This move has a heightened chance of landing a critical hit.

moves.name: Grass Knot
moves.description: The user snares the target with grass and trips it. The heavier the target, the greater the move's power.

moves.name: Smack Down
moves.description: The user throws a stone or similar projectile to attack the target. If the target is in the air, it will be knocked down to the ground.

moves.name: Low Sweep
moves.description: The user makes a swift attack on the target's legs, which lowers the target's Speed stat.

moves.name: High Horsepower
moves.description: The user fiercely attacks the target using its entire body.

moves.name: Coaching
moves.description: The user properly coaches its ally Pokémon, boosting their Attack and Defense stats.

moves.name: Tera Blast
moves.description: If the user has Terastallized, it unleashes energy of its Tera Type. This move inflicts damage using the Attack or Sp. Atk stat—whichever is higher for the user.

moves.name: Counter
moves.description: A retaliatory attack that counters any physical move, inflicting double the damage taken.

moves.name: Mach Punch
moves.description: The user throws a punch at blinding speed. This move always goes first.

moves.name: Detect
moves.description: This move enables the user to protect itself from all attacks. Its chance of failing rises if it is used in succession.

moves.name: Defog
moves.description: A strong wind blows away the target's barriers such as Reflect or Light Screen. This also lowers the target's evasiveness.

moves.name: Wide Guard
moves.description: The user and its allies are protected from wide-ranging attacks for one turn.
